name: application-irrigation-schedule-row
title: Irrigation Schedule Row
description: Per-zone irrigation on/off switch where icon color, name emphasis, and 'Next run' vs. 'Schedule paused' text are all derived from the same real toggled state.
useWhen: Listing sprinkler/irrigation zones in a smart-home or farm-management app where each zone can be independently enabled or disabled.
Each zone benefits from showing its run duration and next scheduled run time, not just an on/off state.
Disabling a zone should visibly suppress its 'Next run' time rather than showing a stale or misleading schedule.
avoidWhen: You're tracking medication doses with per-dose Take/Skip actions — use `medication-schedule-list` for that per-occurrence action pattern instead.
There's no on/off concept, just a fixed schedule to display — a plain schedule list is enough.
Zones need overlapping multi-time schedules shown at once — this row shows only the next single run.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width list (max-w-md) with rows that keep icon and switch sizes fixed; zone name and metadata truncate rather than wrapping onto the switch at narrow widths.
accessibility: The switch uses role="switch" with aria-checked and a zone-specific aria-label, and the icon color, text color, and metadata text are all derived from that same toggled state.
Paused zones show 'Schedule paused' as real text rather than just hiding the next-run time, so the reason for the missing time is always clear.
On/off state is conveyed by switch position and color together with text, never relying on color alone.

variants.title: Irrigation Schedule Row
variants.description: Three zones: Front lawn and Vegetable garden active with next-run times, Backyard drip line paused showing 'Schedule paused' instead of a stale time.
accessibility: Icon color, name emphasis, and metadata text are all derived from the same per-zone toggled state, verified interactively.
